overview_description.description: Shezlong is the first and largest online psychotherapy platform that aims to giving people convenient and private access to professional counseling in Arabic. Founded in 2016 with more than 350 therapists and 100 thousands clients. We primarily target Arab-speaking natives who are mostly allocated within the MENA region. However, Shezlong has experienced significant traction from Arabs all around the world, hitting 85 countries, and still growing exponentially!. Shezlong is the one-stop mental wellness shop that people seek to feel better. Starting from reading detailed and scientific blogs to get guidance, taking psychometric tests to assess their current state, receiving recommendations on the most relevant therapists for your case and booking a session, that's all Shezlong. We're with you 24x7, and we're part of our patients daily routine. And to do that, we empower therapists to become more successful and get closer to their patients!

identifier.value: Aly Zeineldin Chief Product and Commercial Officer @ Shezlong
